data.body: Review remediation and contract evidence: independent five-axis review found the criterion-local schema had drifted from the signed plan, so the rubric/routing checklist now uses assertion_plausible, reason_grounded, and repo_file_change_named exactly. A generated-guide run then exposed a real overlay leak: project-local criteria were emitted into the canonical guide and failed parity. Added a public-contract test using a valid temporary project overlay; it was RED on the orphan section, then GREEN after packaged-only generation was separated from project explain resolution. The test asserts idempotent bytes, parity validation, and public explain behavior—not source text or private shape. Two real regenerations now share SHA-256 88cdd59485dc2bc1b5194bd3ebc3d5b974aa123af8ca6c7893ca4ca90dc9c0c1. Focused suite: 195 passed. Lint, typecheck, diff-check, and module-size checks pass. Independent read-only review approved with no findings and confirmed all tests are behavior/public-contract focused; full make test is running.
